scope: Source-assisted learner task; rubric reviewed for correctness, no participant outcomes invented.

criteria.title: declared-mapping
criteria.acceptance: Reconstruct English B/Bb and German B/H with canonical English spellings and classes 11/10/10/11; do not infer convention from location.

criteria.title: unresolved-outcomes
criteria.acceptance: Keep unspecified B as needs-convention and English H as outside-declared-vocabulary; neither may silently resolve.

criteria.title: source-contract
criteria.acceptance: Identify A-G source grammar, required octave for PitchParser, root-versus-absolute distinction and unanchored-pattern caveat; no claim of fresh C# execution or LilyPond syntax compatibility.

criteria.title: downstream-divergence
criteria.acceptance: Derive English B+2 to class1/C# versus German B normalized Bb+2 to class0/C; arithmetic cannot repair a guessed convention.

criteria.title: reversible-handoff
criteria.acceptance: Retain original token, convention, canonical result and evidence; equal canonical B for English B/German H does not preserve original text; proposed design is not an installed schema.

criteria.title: declared-transpose
criteria.acceptance: Derive 52+0+12*(-1)=40 and concert40+0=40; wrong repeated octave gives28. Chromatic excludes octave contribution; limited ordinary-note scope.

criteria.title: retained-record
criteria.acceptance: Explain actual structural equality of base and transpose inputs, retained E3/52, and missing transpose field; source helper execution is not deployed application behavior.

criteria.title: clef-policy
criteria.acceptance: Explain base/clef-change equality and lost clef octave metadata without treating every clef indicator as a second sounding offset; require file encoding policy.

criteria.title: nested-losses
criteria.acceptance: Explain decimal0.5 becomes absent then defaults0, integer0 remains explicit, and H/missing-octave each retain one note/no pitch; sentinel-999 is not musical; deficient fixtures not schema validated.

criteria.title: discriminating-check
criteria.acceptance: Show 52 and40 share class4 but differ in register; choose an absolute sounding comparison; retain missing schema/import/render/playback/human/learner tests.

criteria.title: direction
criteria.acceptance: Derive B shape/capo2→C# major and sounding B minor/capo4→G minor; add for sound, subtract for shape.

criteria.title: quality-and-scope
criteria.acceptance: Preserve relative major0,4,7 versus minor0,3,7; root-only success misses quality; 12*13*2=312 finite arithmetic cases do not prove arbitrary symbols, routing or comfort.

criteria.title: register
criteria.acceptance: Explain open40+capo12=52 with both class4; a root E cannot certify absolute pitch; tab source inspection is not a fresh converter run.

criteria.title: interpretation-and-spelling
criteria.acceptance: Distinguish C/C# classes0/1 due to different B conventions from Eb/D# same class3 under equal temperament; tool responses have unknown revision and do not execute CapoSkill.

criteria.title: composition-domain
criteria.acceptance: Derive explicitly unapplied64-12+2=54; already-final54 must not become56; clarify shape/written/sounding domain and previously applied adjustments before composing.

pass_policy: All five criteria for a module must be satisfied; record actual answers, assistance, evidence and reviewer decisions. A proposed correction is not a learner result.
